title: Restore UPI Payment Settings, QR Code Logic, and Persistent Admin Settings

requirements.text: Restore the 'UPI Payment Settings' card in the Admin Settings page (AdminSettingsPage.tsx). It must contain a labeled text input field for the UPI ID and a 'Save UPI' button. On click, the button must call the backend mutation to persist the UPI ID to the canister's stable state. The input must be pre-populated with the currently saved UPI ID on page load.

quotes: Restore the 'UPI Payment Settings' card in the Admin Panel. It must have the input field and the 'Save UPI' button. Ensure this button successfully saves my ID to the database.

acceptanceCriteria: The Admin Settings page displays a 'UPI Payment Settings' card with a text input and a 'Save UPI' button.
Entering a UPI ID and clicking 'Save UPI' persists the value to the backend.
On revisiting the Admin Settings page, the saved UPI ID is pre-filled in the input field.
A success or error toast/message is shown after saving.

requirements.text: In the backend (main.mo), ensure the UPI ID is stored in a stable variable so it survives canister upgrades and is never reset. The `getUpiId` query and `setUpiId` update methods must be present and correctly reference this stable variable. Pre-seed the value with '9708075648-1@okbizaxis' as the default if no value has been saved yet.

quotes: Ensure that any settings I save (Logo, UPI, Store Name) are locked in the database and not reset during app updates.
Link this UPI ID 9708075648-1@okbizaxis to generate a dynamic QR code on every bill.

acceptanceCriteria: The UPI ID is stored in a `stable var` in main.mo.
Canister upgrades do not reset the stored UPI ID.
The default value '9708075648-1@okbizaxis' is used when no custom value has been saved.
`getUpiId` returns the current stored UPI ID.
`setUpiId` updates the stored UPI ID and is restricted to admin callers.

requirements.text: In the BillTemplate component, dynamically fetch the saved UPI ID from the backend (via `getUpiId`) and use it to generate the UPI QR code displayed on every bill. The QR code URL must be constructed using the live UPI ID value, not a hardcoded string. The default fallback must be '9708075648-1@okbizaxis' if the backend returns empty.

quotes: Link this UPI ID 9708075648-1@okbizaxis to generate a dynamic QR code on every bill.
Do not delete this logic in the future.

acceptanceCriteria: BillTemplate fetches the UPI ID from the backend before rendering the QR code.
The QR code on every bill reflects the currently saved UPI ID.
If the backend returns an empty value, the QR code uses '9708075648-1@okbizaxis' as fallback.
Changing the UPI ID in Admin Settings causes the QR code on new bills to update accordingly.

requirements.text: Ensure that all persistent admin settings — Store Logo, UPI ID, and Store Name/Slogan — are stored in stable variables in the Motoko backend (main.mo) so they are never reset during canister upgrades. Verify existing stable vars for logo and store name/slogan are present and correctly preserved across upgrades.

quotes: Ensure that any settings I save (Logo, UPI, Store Name) are locked in the database and not reset during app updates.

acceptanceCriteria: Store Logo URL, UPI ID, and Store Name/Slogan are all stored in `stable var` declarations.
A canister upgrade does not reset any of these values.
All three settings can be independently queried and updated via dedicated backend methods.

constraints: Do not remove or overwrite the UPI QR code logic in BillTemplate in future builds.
The UPI ID '9708075648-1@okbizaxis' must be used as the default/fallback value.
Admin-only mutations (setUpiId, setStoreName, setLogo) must remain protected by role-based access control.
Do not edit files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Activating Home Page Coming Soon features (Search, Orders, Wallet) — separate request.
Adding new admin settings beyond UPI, Logo, and Store Name.
Changing the visual theme or layout of the Admin Panel beyond restoring the UPI card.
